activity.notes: A deliberately bounded principal novel-writing period in the Russian Empire: began War and Peace in 1863 (published in installments and completed 1869) and wrote Anna Karenina after beginning it 1873, final publication in 1877/1878 depending serial versus book conventions. Includes the major literary contribution without claiming the writer ceased intellectual or moral/religious writing in 1877, nor retroactively denying later Resurrection (1899). No Activity per volume or title.

sources.title: Leo Tolstoy Archive — biographical chronology
sources.citation_text: The archival biography chronicles writing War and Peace in the 1860s, beginning Anna Karenina in 1873 and completing its edition in 1877.

sources.title: 1911 Encyclopaedia Britannica — Leo Tolstoy
sources.citation_text: Contemporary authoritative reference identifies Tolstoy's two central novels War and Peace and Anna Karenina as his major literary undertakings of the 1860s and 1870s.
